basis.governing_question: How does Banco Atlântico get its new branch operating model running in all 120 branches by week 24?

phases.name: Implementation
phases.objective_one_line: Roll out the new branch operating model to all 120 branches, with staff training and performance tracking running alongside.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Do all 120 branches run the new model, and is the rollout accepted as complete?

architect_notes: No Change & Training or Measurement phase: the brief names one 24-week rollout phase, so training and tracking run as workstreams inside Implementation.
Archetype departure: Diagnostic and Design from operating_model_redesign are dropped because the brief says the model is already designed; Implementation is added.
